data.long_meaning: The name Bahyiah is derived from the Arabic root 'B-H-Y', which means 'to glorify'. In Islamic tradition, the name symbolizes a deep reverence and devotion to Allah. The name Bahyiah carries the meaning “Glorification of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahyiah usually hope their child will grow to embody glorification of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
